description: Update the metadata of a stored template: name, comment, category, tags, deployment timestamp, or expiration. Use deployedAt to activate a specific version for rendering. Use expireAt to schedule or trigger immediate deletion.

deployedAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) to set as the deployment time for this version. Carbone picks the version with the most recent deployedAt when rendering. Use 42000000000 to deploy immediately (special "NOW" value).

expireAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which this template will be automatically deleted. Use 42000000000 to delete immediately.

id.description: Move this version under a DIFFERENT Template ID, re-parenting it so both share a version history. Pass the destination Template ID (64-bit). Leave unset to keep the version where it is — this does not rename anything, use name for that.

tags.description: New list of tags — replaces existing tags entirely.

templateId.description: Template ID (64-bit) or Version ID (SHA-256) to update. Using a Template ID updates the metadata shared by all versions. Using a Version ID updates only that specific version.

name: update_template_metadata
title: Update Template Metadata
